shortDescription: SSC CPO SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 notification released by Staff Selection Commission for 1,871 Sub-Inspector vacancies. Apply online from 10 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the notification for SSC CPO SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 to fill 1,871 Sub-Inspector vacancies in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF).

The online application process is open from 10 September 2026 to 30 September 2026. Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline, and male applicants for the Delhi Police Sub-Inspector (Executive) post must have a valid LMV driving licence on the day of the physical test.

Important dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 10 September 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date: 30 September 2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 01 October 2026
  • Correction Date: 08 – 10 October 2026
  • Exam Date: Notify Later
  • Admit Card: Available Now

Age limit

The minimum age is 20 years and the maximum age is 25 years as on 01 August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable as per SSC rules.

Application fee

The application fee is ₹100 for General/OBC/EWS applicants. SC/ST/Female/PwBD candidates may be exempted. Payment is accepted through debit card, credit card, internet banking, IMPS, cash card or mobile wallet.

Selection process

The recruitment process includes Paper-I, Physical Standard Test / Physical Endurance Test, Paper-II, and Medical Examination.

How to apply

  1. Visit https://ssc.gov.in
  2. Register or log in through the SSC portal
  3. Fill the CPO SI CAPF 2026 application form
  4. Upload the required photograph, signature and certificates
  5. Pay the fee online if applicable and submit the application
  6. Download and keep the final submitted confirmation page

Applicants are advised to read the official SSC notification carefully before applying. Dates, syllabus, vacancies and eligibility details should be confirmed from the official notice.
